title: Add `hasChildren` item template data to the hierarchical menu widget
body:
Hierarchical menu widget should add `hasChildren` template data to the hierarchical menu widget.

This will solve #767

comments.body: Is there any timeframe for this?
Isn't that related to one of the limitations of Hogan as a template system? Isn't this information already encoded in the length of the array containing the children?
Yes you could probably compute it from the length, providing it as a pre computed and named property would make it easier I guess.

I've tried to implement this feature in InstantSearch but with the current implementation it's not very useful. You can see the [code / PoC in this PR](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2638).
@urbanitedesign @ethansmith Can you have a look at the demo in the PR and let me know if it was what you were looking for? I guess not but I could be wrong :)

Implementing a more useful solution would require to do more searches to discover which values may contain children. Let's reopen this issue or open a new one if we see any solution that would not rely on subsequent search.
